title: Affordable Housing through Intentional Community
description: A two-hour online panel from the Foundation for Intentional Community on how cooperatives, community land trusts, cohousing, and multigenerational households make housing affordable in practice — and keep it that way. Five practitioners talk candidly about what has worked and what has been hard: longtime organizer and former FIC executive director Sky Blue, intergenerational-living researcher Savannah Fishel, Madison community land trust and cohousing board member Beth Welch, LIFT Economy's Erin Axelrod, and Hugh Farrell of the Indiana Cooperative Development Center. Includes audience Q&A. Pay-what-you-can, starting at $0. 12-2pm CT.
